town.name: Island Town
town.description: A sleepy fishing town of slate roofs and narrow lanes, its back turned to the forest.

forest_borders.name: Forest Borders
forest_borders.description: Where the last cottages of the town give way to the trees of the southern shore, behind a heavy wooden gate.

enchanted_forest.name: Enchanted Forest
enchanted_forest.description: A small forest on the southern shore of the island, full of dark trees and mysterious glows.

kobold_barrows.name: Barrow Mounds
kobold_barrows.description: A clearing of low, grass-grown mounds, their sides broken open as though something dug its way out.

tomb_entrance.name: Tomb Entrance
tomb_entrance.description: A moss-covered stone doorway, sealed shut and half-buried in the forest floor.

crypt.name: Crypt
crypt.description: A low vaulted passage of niches and old bones beyond the sealed door, lit by a faint glow with no source.
